key_insight: Compass improves prostate cancer detection by analyzing micro-ultrasound as a multi-view video stream rather than isolated frames.
clinical_relevance: Using rotational sweep context and biopsy-time frames may better reflect how expert readers assess micro-ultrasound studies for prostate cancer risk.
method: Models a full micro-ultrasound study as a sequence of 2D images.
Combines rotational prostate sweeps with biopsy-acquisition frames.
Uses a transformer conditioned on probe rotation to aggregate evidence and output frame-level and study-level risk scores.
evidence_signal: The model was trained and evaluated on a multi-center clinical trial dataset and compared against published AI baselines and clinical expert risk scores.
watch_item: Performance depends on access to complete, well-registered multi-view micro-ultrasound video data, which may limit real-world deployment if acquisition is inconsistent.
paper_title: Compass: Prostate Cancer Detection Needs Multi-View Context
